plan.title: Treated vs control liver: descriptive DE (no replication)
plan.analytical_narrative: The dataset is a 1 treated vs 1 control human liver comparison with no biological replication (counts.csv: 12000 genes x 2 samples, salmon gene-level counts; metadata.csv: one row per sample, condition column). With one sample per condition, no within-group variance exists, so no dispersion can be estimated and no inferential differential expression test (DESeq2 Wald/LRT, edgeR QL, limma) has an inferential basis — the knowledge service flags this design (R-0003@6b3a) and prescribes a descriptive-only outcome. The plan therefore: (1) runs sample-structure QC on the two samples (vst blind, PCA on top-variance genes, library sizes) to confirm the samples are comparable and that the condition axis separates them; (2) applies the standard pre-filter (>=10 counts in at least the smallest group size, i.e. 1 sample), computes median-of-ratios size factors, and produces a full gene table of normalized counts with descriptive log2 fold changes treated-vs-control, ranked by effect size — explicitly with no p-values and no adjusted p-values, since neither is defensible here; (3) writes a reproducibility report that names the design, states the no-replication limitation, and names the design (multiple biological replicates per condition) that would support inference. The research question is gene-level differential expression only, so no pathway/TF steps are added (unasked scope). Note on R-0018: only the gene-level count matrix is staged (no transcript-level quant files), so tximport length-scaled TPM/offsets are not applicable; the gene-level matrix is used as-is and this is recorded in the report.

pre-filter keep genes with at least 10 counts in at least the smallest group size of samples
design ~ condition, explicit reference level, contrast named as factor numerator denominator
descriptive log2 fold changes only, no inferential test
reproducibility report with method, versions, design, thresholds, n_tested, session_info
